name: SEC22B-YKT6-STX5-GOSR1-SCFD1 ER-Golgi SNARE/tethering and NSF/GDI2 vesicle recycling axis
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Unbundling isolates 3 genuine human ALS nodes: (1) YKT6 (C015-N3) converges across exome-wide rare missense p.Tyr64Cys (OR=2.84, P=9.08e-8; AlphaGenome AVI Phred=20.02, top 0.995%), 3.46A heavy-atom contact of Tyr64 to lipid DPV201 inside the Longin autoinhibitory groove (PDB 3KYQ), TDP-43 3'UTR lengthening (dPAS=+0.1417, padj=4.57e-40), TDP-43 frameshifting exon skip in its geranylgeranyltransferase PTAR1 (dPSI=+0.1563, FDR=3.26e-6), and sALS neuronal mRNA reduction (unadjusted Pineda BA9_Exc -0.464, p=4.53e-4; BA4_Exc -0.285, p=0.0263; GC+cell-comp-adjusted NYGC Motor beta=-0.080, p=0.035); (2) SCFD1 (C015-N1) colocalizes at chr14q12 with AALS-594 iPSC-MN ISL1-footprint eQTL rs229143 (padj<2e-32; AVI Phred=10.27); and (3) G2E3 (C015-N2) combines colocalized 14q12 exon-2 sQTL rs229190 (padj<6e-32; AVI Phred=7.61) + 5/5-study TDP-43 Intron-1 cryptic ALE (dPSI=+0.4044, FDR=2.90e-21) with cellular non-essentiality across 1,258 DepMap lines (mean Chronos=-0.0184 vs SCFD1 -1.2619 and YKT6 -1.5425).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Refutes ExploreALS composite Tier 1A (81.0) bundling of 5/8 nodes and chemical probe claims: GDI2 CSF sALS vs Ctrl is protein-level null in Set 2 DIA (diff=+0.0200, p=0.5042; Emory p=0.9266) and Set 1 TMT (diff=+0.0245, p=0.2085) with 4/5 peptides null; NSF (DepMap Chronos=-2.4404, 100/100 liability, DEE96) and STX5 (DepMap Chronos=-1.1332, 100/100 liability, STX5-CDG) are pan-essential and null in Spillman MOESM1 cortical DIA proteomics (NSF Homog p=0.096/Synapt p=0.084; STX5 Homog p=0.708/Synapt p=0.473); SEC22B (Homog p=0.561/Synapt p=0.758) and GOSR1 (Brown RNA padj=0.854; CSF p=0.355; MOESM1 Homog padj=0.339) are null; G2E3 cryptic junction is 0.54% (selective=False) in NYGC bulk and undetected in MOESM1 proteomics; YKT6 DepMap Chronos=-1.5425 rules out knockdown/inhibition; and CHEMBL3752910 (SCFD1 Kd=171 nM) is a promiscuous Eph kinase inhibitor (EPHA3 IC50=0.3 nM, PTAR1 Kd=15.5 nM).
factual_justification: Retain ONLY the unbundled YKT6 (strictly as a positive Longin-groove conformational chaperone hypothesis given DepMap Chronos=-1.54) and chr14q12 G2E3 (DepMap non-essential Chronos=-0.018) / SCFD1 sub-nodes as exploratory unproven targets while dropping SEC22B, STX5, GOSR1, NSF, and GDI2 from the composite bundle.
discriminating_next_test: Isogenic human iPSC-MN knock-in of YKT6 p.Tyr64Cys +/- TDP-43 knockdown measuring closed-vs-open YKT6 prenyl partitioning, Cys64-Cys66 disulfide trapping, Golgi/autophagosome SNARE flux, and 19F-NMR/DSF fragment screening for positive allosteric stabilizers of the 3KYQ Longin lipid groove (plus CRISPRi/base-editing dissection of rs229143 SCFD1 vs non-essential rs229190 G2E3 in iPSC-MNs).

name: FBXL5
evidence_proves_hypothesis: TDP-43 depletion induces coordinated distal 3'UTR lengthening of BOTH FBXL5 (chr4:15604539:-, dPAS=+0.0873, padj=4.45e-4) and its direct substrate IREB2/IRP2 (chr15:78501450:+, dPAS=+0.1279, padj=3.02e-24) alongside FTH1 (dPAS=+0.0785, S4 padj=5.31e-45) and ACO1 (dPAS=+0.0948, padj=0.00883) plus TFRC/FTL KD mRNA upregulation; postmortem tissues show GC-adjusted NYGC FBXL5 RNA elevation (GC=37.97%: Motor n=205 adj_beta=+0.1758, p=3.38e-5; Frontal n=257 +0.1342, p=3.22e-5; Spinal n=262 +0.1990, p=8.03e-4), Spillman MOESM1 cortical DIA proteomics iron-axis remodeling (Synaptosome TFRC log2FC=-1.2067, p=7.08e-4, padj=0.109; Homogenate IREB2 -0.6213, p=0.0259; Homogenate ACO1 +0.4150, p=0.0071), and elevated CSF ceruloplasmin (DIA p=0.0273). Structures 3V5Z and 6VCD prove FBXL5 requires [Fe-O-Fe] and [2Fe-2S] cofactors to engage IRP2 (37 contacts <=4.0A).
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Two major risks lower scientific taste despite valid Epistemic Asymmetry retention: (1) Cell-type split & compensatory glial risk: single-nucleus pseudobulks show FBXL5 mRNA is completely flat in human sALS excitatory neurons (Pineda BA9_Exc p=0.628, BA4_Exc p=0.208; Edinburgh Exc p=0.179) while upregulated in microglia (Edinburgh log2FC=+0.474, p=8.04e-4) and astrocytes (BA4_Astro +0.246, p=0.0316) alongside FTH1/FTL ferritin co-induction, consistent with reactive glial iron-buffering secondary to motor-neuron death, and FBXL5 protein itself is UNDETECTED in Spillman MOESM1 cortical & MOESM3 iPSC DIA proteomics; (2) Indiscriminate iron chelation (Deferiprone 2.5 uM, ~13 uM free-brain exposure) failed in 16 sALS iPSC-MN lines in Bye 2025 (mean=+0.115d, med=-0.274d, t=0.41, p=0.686, Wilcoxon p=0.860, 9/16 worsened; -3.72d vs Riluzole p=9.2e-9) and worsened PD/AD in FAIRPARK-II/FAIR-AD because stripping iron destabilizes holo-FBXL5, while FBXL5 (KO E8.5 lethal, 5D=75/100) and IREB2 (OMIM 618451 neurodegeneration, 5D=78/100) impose a narrow bidirectional safety window.
factual_justification: Under Epistemic Asymmetry, Deferiprone's failure falsifies bulk iron chelation (which strips Fe2+/[2Fe-2S] out of FBXL5) rather than holo-FBXL5 modulation, and FBXL5 protein abundance in human ALS motor neurons has never been measured; however, taste is downgraded to LOW_TO_MODERATE_COMPENSATORY_GLIAL_RISK because postmortem FBXL5 mRNA elevation is glial rather than neuronal.
discriminating_next_test: Cell-type-resolved bidirectional perturbation (holo-FBXL5 stabilization/overexpression vs partial knockdown, with Deferiprone 2.5 uM as negative control) measuring endogenous FBXL5 & IRP2 protein half-lives, cytosolic labile Fe2+, TFRC/ferritin translation, and lipid-ROS ferroptotic survival across BOTH TDP-43-depleted human iPSC-MNs AND iron-challenged human iPSC microglia-motor-neuron co-cultures before committing to therapeutic sign.

name: Lonafarnib / Tipifarnib (FTIs)
evidence_proves_hypothesis: Lonafarnib (CHEMBL298734, FTase IC50=1.9 nM) and Tipifarnib (CHEMBL289228, FTase IC50=0.57-0.90 nM) potently inhibit protein farnesyltransferase in biochemical assays and reduce mutant progerin/Rhes farnesylation in non-ALS models.
evidence_disproves_hypothesis: Falsified on three independent axes: (1) Directional paradox: GGTase-III (PTAR1/RABGGTB, PDB 6J74) strictly requires prior FTase Cys195 farnesylation to geranylgeranylate YKT6 Cys194 (pan-essential DepMap Chronos=-1.5425), so FTIs block YKT6 maturation and worsen the exact TDP-43-driven YKT6 APA (padj=4.57e-40) + PTAR1 frameshifting exon-skipping (dPSI=+0.1563, FDR=3.26e-6) defect in sALS MNs; (2) Unbound CNS PK deficit: Lonafarnib (MW 638.83 Da, PPB>=99%, marginal P-gp substrate) achieves Cmax,u<=42.2 nM at 150 mg/m2 BID and estimated Cu,brain<=2.1-8.4 nM (Tipifarnib Cu,brain<=2.0-12.8 nM) vs 70-500 nM cellular IC50 (8x->100x gap); (3) Human toxicity: ZOKINVY causes 90% vomiting, 81% diarrhea, 37% weight loss (lethal risk factor in ALS), 35% myelosuppression, +19ms QTc prolongation, and severe CYP3A autoinhibition/DDIs.
factual_justification: Dropped due to human unbound CNS exposure deficit (Cu,brain <=2-13 nM vs 70-500 nM cellular IC50), ALS-hostile human clinical toxicities (37% weight loss, 81-90% GI toxicity, 35% myelosuppression, +19ms QTc), and direct mechanistic antagonism of essential YKT6 Cys195/Cys194 dual prenylation in TDP-43-compromised motor neurons.
